core: Intraflagellar transport and cilium length control
name: Intraflagellar transport governing cilium growth and resorption
rationale: All members concern anterograde/retrograde IFT and positive or negative control of cilium assembly, centriole elongation and disassembly; unlike its superset it lacks basal body docking, transition zone and centrosome duplication.

qualifier: basal body docking and transition zone
name: Intraflagellar transport, basal body docking and transition zone ciliogenesis
rationale: Members span IFT and cilium assembly/disassembly control plus basal body anchoring, transition-zone protein targeting and centrosome duplication, which the smaller IFT theme lacks.

name: Transferrin, heme, copper, manganese and cobalt ion transport
rationale: All members are cellular transport/homeostasis of iron (transferrin, heme, ferroportin/DMT1 defects), copper, manganese and cobalt; it lacks the systemic iron homeostasis and iron-response members of its superset.

core: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
name: Systemic iron homeostasis with heme, copper and manganese transport
rationale: Members cover heme, transferrin, copper, manganese and cobalt transport plus organismal iron homeostasis, iron import and cellular iron response, which distinguish it from the smaller transport-only theme.

core: Kinesin cargo transport and ER tubule shaping
name: Neuronal kinesin cargo transport and ER tubular network formation
rationale: Members are kinesin/Miro-driven transport of mitochondria, synaptic and dense-core vesicles and receptors in neurons together with ER tubule formation and fusion; it lacks the ER positioning and membrane tethering members of its superset.

core: Kinesin organelle transport and ER tubular network
qualifier: ER positioning and membrane contact tethering
name: Kinesin transport, ER tubular network and organelle membrane tethering
rationale: Members combine kinesin/Miro organelle transport and ER tubule shaping with ER localization, ER-plasma membrane and mitochondria-ER tethering and autophagosome docking, which the smaller theme lacks.

name: LXR-driven lipogenesis and triglyceride storage balance
rationale: All six members concern LXR-controlled lipogenesis, triglyceride synthesis/lipolysis and fatty acid and VLDL handling, without the gluconeogenesis, adipose development and caloric restriction members of its superset.

name: LXR regulation of triglyceride, gluconeogenesis and adipose development
rationale: Members are LXR-regulated lipogenesis, lipolysis and gluconeogenesis plus bidirectional triglyceride synthesis control, adipose tissue development and caloric restriction response, which extend it beyond the smaller lipogenesis theme.

name: Reverse cholesterol transport via HDL and cellular sterol homeostasis
rationale: Members cover LXR/ABCA1-driven cholesterol efflux, HDL assembly and foam cell control plus reverse cholesterol transport, HDL clearance, cholesterol endocytosis and biosynthesis suppression, which the smaller foam-cell theme lacks.

qualifier: oxidised LDL response and HDL assembly
name: Macrophage foam cell formation, oxLDL response and HDL assembly
rationale: All members concern macrophage cholesterol import, storage and ABCA1/apoA-I efflux to nascent HDL and the foam cell response to oxidised LDL, without the reverse transport, HDL clearance and sterol homeostasis members of its superset.

name: RUNX1-regulated megakaryocyte-erythroid differentiation and platelet formation
rationale: Members span megakaryocyte and erythroid differentiation and platelet morphogenesis together with RUNX1 regulation and a platelet signalling module, which the smaller theme lacks.

name: Megakaryocyte development, platelet morphogenesis and terminal erythropoiesis
rationale: All six members are megakaryocyte differentiation/development, platelet morphogenesis and erythroid commitment and terminal maturation modules, without the RUNX1 and platelet-signalling members of its superset.

name: Meiotic DSB formation, synaptonemal complex and crossover resolution
rationale: All members are core prophase I events: programmed DSB formation and repair, telomere-led homolog pairing, synaptonemal complex and resolution of recombination intermediates, without the checkpoint and strand-invasion members of its superset.

qualifier: meiotic checkpoint arrest and strand invasion
name: Meiotic recombination and synapsis with meiotic checkpoint arrest
rationale: Members cover meiotic DSB formation, strand invasion, synapsis and crossover resolution in both sexes plus meiotic checkpoint signaling and inhibition of nuclear division, which the smaller theme lacks.

core: MHC class II and CD1 antigen presentation
name: MHC class II and CD1 antigen presentation with TLR7/8 cluster
rationale: Members are MHC class II peptide and CD1 lipid antigen presentation modules co-clustered with TLR7/TLR8; it lacks the NKT cell regulation members of its superset.

core: MHC class II and CD1 antigen presentation
name: MHC class II and CD1 presentation driving NKT cell activation
rationale: Members combine MHC class II and CD1 lipid antigen presentation with regulation of NKT cell activation, proliferation and differentiation, which distinguish it from the presentation-only theme.

core: MHC class II peptide antigen presentation
name: Regulation of MHC class II peptide antigen presentation
rationale: Members are exogenous peptide loading onto MHC class II plus its positive and negative regulation, which the smaller core-presentation theme lacks.

core: MHC class II peptide processing and loading
name: Core MHC class II peptide processing and loading
rationale: All five members are the basic exogenous peptide processing and MHC class II assembly steps (including germinal center B cells), without the regulatory members of the larger theme.

name: Alzheimer amyloid-beta production, clearance and microglial-astrocyte activation
rationale: Members cover amyloid-beta formation, fibrillization and clearance with microglial and astrocyte activation, plus tangle assembly, LTP suppression and lysosomal/glucosylceramide regulation that the other microglial themes lack.

name: Microglial phagocytic clearance of amyloid-beta and apoptotic cells
rationale: Members are microglial activation, migration and cytotoxicity with amyloid-beta catabolic clearance and fibril control plus apoptotic cell clearance and membrane invagination, without the negative-regulation members of its superset.

name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta clearance with inhibitory feedback
rationale: Members are microglial activation and phagocytic amyloid-beta and apoptotic cell clearance, and uniquely include negative regulation of microglial activation and of amyloid-beta clearance.

name: Microglial efferocytosis via phosphatidylserine recognition and DAP12 signaling
rationale: Members cover microglial differentiation and activation with apoptotic cell PS exposure, recognition and engulfment, neutrophil clearance and DAP12 signaling; it lacks the glial proliferation and kainate injury members of its superset.

name: Microglial efferocytosis with glial proliferation and excitotoxic neuronal injury
rationale: Members include microglial apoptotic cell recognition and engulfment with DAP12 signaling plus glial proliferation and apoptosis, astrocyte activation, kainic acid response and amyloid-beta formation, which the smaller theme lacks.

name: Mitochondrial DNA maintenance, mRNA stability and mitoribosome translation
rationale: Members span mtDNA replication and repair, mitochondrial transcription, mRNA stability/decay and mitoribosome assembly and translation, without the tRNA processing and RNA import members of its superset.

name: Mitochondrial gene expression including tRNA processing and RNA import
rationale: Members cover mtDNA replication, transcription, RNA stability and translation plus mitochondrial tRNA processing/modification, RNA 3'-end processing, tRNA transport and RNA import, which the smaller theme lacks.
